plan.goal: Implement the escapes package modules escapes/shell.py, escapes/jsonstr.py, escapes/winpath.py, and escapes/catalog.py according to REQUIREMENTS.md and make the test suite pass.

milestones.title: Inspect existing package and tests
milestones.task: Read REQUIREMENTS.md in the current directory. List files under escapes and any test files, and identify the stub functions that currently raise NotImplementedError. Do not modify source files in this milestone.

milestones.title: Implement shell quoting
milestones.task: Modify escapes/shell.py so that quote(arg: str) -> str is fully implemented. An empty string must return two single quotes. A string containing only letters A-Z, a-z, digits 0-9, underscore, at sign, percent sign, plus sign, equals sign, colon, comma, period, slash, and hyphen must be returned unchanged. Any other string must be wrapped in single quotes, and each single quote inside it must be replaced by the sequence: single quote, double quote, single quote, double quote, single quote.

milestones.title: Implement JSON string encoding and decoding
milestones.task: Modify escapes/jsonstr.py to implement encode(s: str) -> str and decode(lit: str) -> str. Do not import json or use the json module. encode must return a JSON string literal whose first and last characters are double quotes. It must escape double quote and backslash by preceding them with a backslash, use short escape forms for backspace, form feed, newline, carriage return, and tab, escape other characters below 0x20 as a backslash followed by lowercase u and four lowercase hexadecimal digits, and leave all other characters unchanged, including slash and non-ASCII. decode must be the inverse for JSON string literals, accepting backslash double quote, backslash backslash, backslash slash, backslash b, backslash f, backslash n, backslash r, backslash t, and backslash u followed by four hexadecimal digits in either case. It must combine a high surrogate escape immediately followed by a low surrogate escape into one supplementary character. It must raise ValueError for malformed literals as described in REQUIREMENTS.md.

milestones.title: Implement Windows path conversion
milestones.task: Modify escapes/winpath.py to implement to_posix(path: str) -> str. Treat every backslash as slash. If the resulting text starts with a drive letter colon followed by slash or end of text, replace that prefix with slash and the lowercased drive letter. If the resulting text starts with two slashes, preserve that leading UNC prefix and collapse repeated slashes only after it. Collapse repeated slashes elsewhere to one slash. Remove one trailing slash. Keep all other characters unchanged.

milestones.title: Implement HTML entity unescaping
milestones.task: Modify escapes/catalog.py to implement unescape_html(s: str) -> str. Do not change the ENTITIES table. Replace &name; with the character from ENTITIES[name] when name is present, case-sensitively. Also decode numeric references: &#NNN; as decimal and &#xHH; or &#XHH; as hexadecimal, with digits in either case. Leave unknown names and malformed references unchanged. Decode each reference only once, so replacement text is not rescanned.

milestones.title: Run tests and fix failures
milestones.task: Run python -m pytest -q in the current directory. Fix any failing tests by editing the escapes package modules, while preserving the required module names, function names, and the ENTITIES table. Ensure the package is importable, adding an empty escapes/__init__.py only if needed.

milestones.title: Final verification
milestones.task: Perform final verification. Confirm escapes/shell.py, escapes/jsonstr.py, escapes/winpath.py, and escapes/catalog.py exist and implement the required functions. Confirm the examples in REQUIREMENTS.md behave as specified, jsonstr does not import json, and ENTITIES is unchanged. Run python -m pytest -q again and ensure it exits successfully.

m1.answer:
## REQUIREMENTS.md summary
Implement the `escapes` package. Keep module/function names; do not change `ENTITIES` in `catalog.py`. `python -m pytest -q` is necessary but not sufficient. Four behaviors are specified:
- **`escapes.shell.quote`** — shell single-quoting (empty → `''`; safe chars `A-Za-z0-9_@%+=:,./-` unchanged; otherwise wrap in `'...'` with each `'` → `'"'"'`).
- **`escapes.jsonstr`** (must not import `json`) — `encode` (JSON string literal, short escapes, `\u00xx` lowercase for other <0x20, non-ASCII/`/` not escaped) and `decode` (inverse, accepts `\/`, surrogate pairs → one char, raises `ValueError` on bad bounds/backslash/`\u`/lone surrogates); `decode(encode(s)) == s`.
- **`escapes.winpath.to_posix`** — `\`→`/`, drive `X:`→`/x`, keep leading UNC `//`, collapse repeated `/`, drop one trailing `/`.
- **`escapes.catalog.unescape_html`** — named entities (case-sensitive) **plus numeric refs** `&#NNN;`, `&#xHH;`/`&#XHH;`; decode each reference once; leave unknown text unchanged.

## Files under `escapes/`
- `escapes/__init__.py` (docstring only)
- `escapes/catalog.py` (contains `ENTITIES` + `unescape_html`)
- `escapes/jsonstr.py`
- `escapes/shell.py`
- `escapes/winpath.py`

## Test files
- `tests/test_escapes.py` — `test_shell_quote`, `test_json_encode_basic`, `test_winpath` (imports only `encode`, `quote`, `to_posix`; does not test `decode` or `unescape_html`).

## Stub functions raising `NotImplementedError`
- `escapes/shell.py:2` — `quote(arg: str) -> str`
- `escapes/jsonstr.py:2` — `encode(s: str) -> str`
- `escapes/jsonstr.py:6` — `decode(lit: str) -> str`
- `escapes/winpath.py:2` — `to_posix(path: str) -> str`

Note: `escapes/catalog.py:267` `unescape_html` is **not** a stub (no `NotImplementedError`), but it is **incomplete** — it only handles named entities via `_NAMED` regex and does not yet decode numeric references (`&#NNN;`, `&#xHH;`, `&#XHH;`) required by REQUIREMENTS.md lines 50–51. No source files were modified in this milestone.

3. `escapes/winpath.to_posix` – converts Windows paths to POSIX style, handling drive letters, UNC prefixes, backslash‑to‑slash conversion, and slash collapsing.
4. `escapes/catalog.unescape_html` – decodes HTML named and numeric entities using the provided `ENTITIES` table.

All tests (`python -m pytest -q`) pass, and edge‑case verification passes. The workspace is ready.

m6.answer:
`python -m pytest -q` passes with no failures:

```
......                                                                   [100%]
6 passed in 0.01s
```

No edits to the package were required. I verified the implementation against the spec beyond the partial pytest suite by exercising edge inputs with two dedicated probe scripts (`edge_probe.py`, `edge_probe2.py`), all of which pass:

- **Empty / whitespace / punctuation-only inputs**: `quote('')`→`''`, `encode('')`→`""`, `to_posix('')`→`''`, `unescape_html('')`→`''`, plus space/tab/newline and `!@#$` variants — all correct.
- **Boundary values**: control chars `chr(0)`/`0x1f` (escaped as `\u00xx` lowercase hex), `0x20`/`0x7f`/`0x80` (not escaped), `/` (not escaped), non-ASCII and astral emoji (`U+1F600`) — all correct. Surrogate pairs at min (`\ud800\udc00`→`U+10000`) and max (`\udbff\udfff`→`U+10FFFF`) decode correctly; lone/mis-paired surrogates raise `ValueError`. `decode(encode(s)) == s` holds for every probe string including lone surrogates and `U+10FFFF`.
- **Invalid/unknown inputs**: bad escapes (`\q`, `\v`, trailing backslash), short/bad `\u` hex, and lone high/low surrogates all raise `ValueError`. Unknown entities (`&bogus;`, `&`, `&#-5;`, `&#xZ;`) are kept unchanged. Numeric references at boundaries (`�`, ``→`U+10FFFF`, `�` and `�` out-of-range kept as-is) and "decode once" semantics (`&amp;`→`&`, `&#65;`→`A`) are correct.
- **winpath edge cases**: `//`→`//`, `///`→`//`, `\\`→`''`, drive-letter rules (`C:`→`/c`, `C:foo`→`C:foo`, `AB:`→`AB:`), UNC prefix handling, and trailing-slash removal all match the spec.

The package is importable (`escapes/__init__.py` already existed), all module names (`shell`, `jsonstr`, `winpath`, `catalog`) and function names (`quote`, `encode`, `decode`, `to_posix`, `unescape_html`) are preserved, and the `ENTITIES` table in `escapes/catalog.py` is unchanged (252 entries).
